name: 毎週の参加可能時間
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH11-0015 毎週の参加可能時間 component. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source takes priority for status-dot geometry, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and fine row/edit details; Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized content/layout guide. Image3 approved bus is white rounded cards/quiet elevation style only. Target only the recurring-week list, no full profile/sidebar, photo, global Add availability, titlebar or close action.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, logical640x616 compact composition at high resolution. Small regular14/24 Meiryo section label 「繰り返し」. Seven consistent WHITE rounded day cards with fine neutral borders and subtle soft shadows, restrained gaps (about12logicalpx), no outer nested wrapper. Each card: bold14/24 weekday at upper left; below a TINY FOREST-GREEN STATUS DOT about5logicalpx and regular12/16 text 「毎週・終日参加できます」; right small regular12/16 forest-green text action 「編集」, aligned as original.
Days exact, in order: 「月曜日」「火曜日」「水曜日」「木曜日」「金曜日」「土曜日」「日曜日」. All seven carry the exact same existing status text and one 編集 action. Preserve all seven rows; do not cut off Sunday like the original screenshot viewport. Sunday status is explicit in our saved Japanese mock, not invented. Keep original small dot and edit optical size; no decorative icons, circles behind icons, checkboxes, switches, hour ranges, dates, counts or extra controls.
Accent decision: original green dot means available, retained consistently as forest-green #1F6444 with status text. Original purple edit links become same forest-green action color. All card surfaces WHITE instead of source/mock broad gray panels; main ink #1D1D1D, supporting text #6E6E6E. No status palettes per weekday, no mint wash, colored cards, big gradient button or decorative gloss. Meiryo roles as above, tracking0; do not enlarge heading or bold status/body. Calm compact readable row hierarchy with complete Japanese and consistent alignment. Static raster candidate, no live availability/edit behavior claimed.
reviewNotes: 原画優先の小さい参加可状態点/曜日/右編集を七行で保持。全曜日と毎週・終日参加できます、編集、日本語/整列/切れなしを実見。紫編集を森林緑、状態点は意味を保持し森林緑、広い灰面は白いカードと中立境界へ。日曜の状態文は保存モックに明示。実参加可否/編集動作や正確なフォント同定は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
